item.title: Chris Paul announces NBA retirement after 21 seasons
item.description: Chris Paul, the legendary "Point God" who redefined floor generalship for a generation, has officially announced his retirement from the NBA. Paul, 40, confirmed his decision via an Instagram post on Friday, February 13.In his retirement statement, Paul reflected on his long journey with gratitude."This is it! After over 21 years I'm stepping away from basketball. As I write this, it's hard to really know what to feel, but for once – most people would be surprised – I don't have the answer lol!

item.title: California designates coastal mountain lions as threatened species
item.description: California wildlife officials have granted permanent protected status to mountain lion populations stretching from the Bay Area to the Mexican border. The ruling lists six distinct groups of mountain lions as "threatened" under the California Endangered Species Act (CESA). These cats, which represent about one-third of the state’s estimated 4,200 cougars, face "extinction vortex" conditions due to habitat fragmentation.
